evidence: SCOPE: 3 gate, 43 Functional and 6 Polish binary criteria and 3 Visual likert criteria were each walked against the frozen reference. RESULT: all but one are plausibly satisfied; one gate step is not safely satisfiable through the judge's own browser tool. DEFECT (render gate vs reference): tests/gates/render/judge.toml, cw_workspace_loads_and_takes_typing: "Click into the code editing area and type one short distinctive word with real key presses ... Reload the page: the workspace must load again ... Fails if ... the workspace does not load again after the reload." The reference blocks unload whenever the draft is dirty, solution/app/src/app.tsx:126: "const beforeUnload = event => { if (current.current.dirty) { event.preventDefault(); event.returnValue = ''; } };" and a typed word on a fresh page makes the draft dirty (app.tsx:43). MEASURED with the judge's tool (playwright-mcp 0.0.79 from cw-editor-verifier:current, same args as judge.toml; frozen solution installed by solve.sh and launched as test.sh launches it): browser_navigate, browser_click on the editor, five browser_press_key calls, then browser_navigate to http://localhost:3000 again returned after 60027 ms (60011 ms on a second run) with only "### Error TimeoutError: browserBackend.callTool: Timeout 60000ms exceeded. Call log: - navigating to \"http://localhost:3000/\", waiting until \"domcontentloaded\"" and no mention of a dialog. The next call answered "Tool \"browser_snapshot\" does not handle the modal state"; browser_handle_dialog with accept=true then let the page load. browser_press_key F5 did not reload the page at all. So the reference passes this all_pass gate only if the judge, after a 60 s tool timeout on the reload, discovers and accepts a leave-page dialog. tests/app_context.md mitigates ("The app may ask for confirmation before discarding an unsaved draft; accepting that dialog is normal"), but the render prompt also says "If a feature does not work as delivered, that criterion fails and scores 0" and "Never look for a workaround that makes a broken feature pass". tests/scoring.toml makes render a gate, so a wrong reading zeroes the Oracle reward. NOT MEASURED: no configured judge run exists for these bytes. The hosted run on the earlier candidate (reward 0.9833, Functional 41/41, Polish 6/6, Visual 0.9167) had a different render criterion, cw_authored_custom_editor_run, with no reload step, and the reloads it reports followed a Save. The scripted check passes because tests/lib.cjs registers "page.on('dialog', dialog => dialog.accept())", which the judge tool does not do. The same stall can occur in polish cw_narrow_width_usable ("Resize ... and reload") if the draft is dirty at that moment. WHAT HOLDS UP: the scripted results list all 3 gate, 43 Functional and 6 Polish ids as true with no page errors, and restart.json shows the record intact after a real process restart. Code reading agrees for every other criterion: server.js (revision check, restore idempotent by operationId), custom-editor.js (grapheme steps, multi-caret offsets, undo grouping with no timer, literal find and replace, block indent), runtime.ts (line attribution, five-second budget and fresh budget on interaction, last-good restore with form and canvas state, CSP and sandbox isolation). Own probes with fixtures different from the scripted ones all passed: document.write and innerHTML sums (579, 777) in preview and console; real Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V with one-step Undo of a two-line paste; three compact HTML documents and two compact JS programs formatted to two-space nesting with identical rendering, an idempotent second Format ("Already formatted.") and exact one-step Undo and Redo; eval, Function, WebAssembly (async and sync), blob and data Worker and dynamic import all refused with a visible reason and no payload marker, also inside try/catch; six unhandled-rejection variants reported the authored message and the right line (3 or 4). NOTES: (1) Visual is unmeasured for these bytes, and the layout CSS and toolbar markup changed after the 0.9167 measurement; the 1440 px screenshot looks coherent. (2) At about 20:27 the shared working tree was switched to branch task/hireops-live-desk (git reflog), so every artifact path in the evidence index vanished from the working tree mid-round. All 22 hashes matched on my first check before the switch; afterwards 20 of 22 matched from git objects at commit 4b3bef67, and the two files of run 6e537d14 differed there (probably line-ending normalisation). The frozen .qc-cache copy was unaffected and is what I tested. (3) The scripted results were produced from projects/ on the previous commit; the index states that only the judge prompt.md files differ, and the frozen task was identical to projects/ when I diffed it before the switch. (4) A container named cw-row18-r2 exists that I did not create; I left it alone. My own container cw-row18-app is removed.
counterexample: The judge runs the render gate exactly as written against the reference: it types a word, then reloads with browser_navigate. The tool returns "TimeoutError: browserBackend.callTool: Timeout 60000ms exceeded" after 60 s and names no dialog. A judge that reads this as "the workspace does not load again after the reload" fails the all_pass render gate and the Oracle reward is 0, although the reference is correct. The tool behaviour was reproduced twice; the configured judge's reaction to it is not measured.
suggested_fix: Make the gate independent of leave-page prompts: drop the reload step, or reword it (and the reload notes in app_context.md) to say that a leave-page confirmation must be accepted and that a navigation call that stalls while such a dialog is open is not a failed reload; optionally also remove the beforeunload handler from the reference. Then measure the gate with the configured judge on the new bytes.
